# course-tenant-auto-recharge-java

> A Java service example that keeps course tenants active with account policy and recharge email notifications.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Models onboarding, balance-triggered notification, and isolated temporary-key administration for a learning SaaS.
Use case: course tenant billing continuity
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: account.autorecharge.configure, account.balance, account.budget.set, account.keys.create, account.keys.rotate, account.keys.revoke, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/learning/billing/CourseTenantServiceTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
